decision: Reject predictive PPO v23 as an improvement on this matched HalfCheetah pilot. Retain ordinary Adam; do not promote or extend transport to other environments from these results.

measurement.step_explanation: 16000 stochastic phase-warmup transitions plus 243 complete 32768-transition rollouts; inherited floor schedule. Last episodic return is at 7978000.
measurement.final_score: Mean of final 100 logged training episodes, not separate deterministic evaluation.
measurement.matched_windows: Return and diagnostic means over target step +/-50000; 8M window ends early at actual recorded end. Counts retained; diagnostics are sparse (roughly 3 rollout entries per 100k window).
measurement.uncertainty: Single-seed pilot; correlated episodes do not establish seed-level confidence intervals. No best-of-seed or best-checkpoint selection.

findings: All four transport arms underperform their same-beta Adam control at 1M, 2M, 4M, and the final-100 endpoint.
At beta .9, critic-only loses 6.75% and actor+critic loses 34.24%; at beta .99, losses are 39.66% and 58.73%.

At 4M with beta .99, actor+critic has KL .001132 vs Adam .010090, while explained variance .97094 exceeds Adam .87494 despite much lower return (1432 vs 7266). Critic explained variance alone is not a policy-quality metric.
All logged scalars finite. All six initialization hashes, source hashes, runtime versions, and non-treatment arguments match. Recorded sources still match working files.

Median post-first rollout update phase is 21.35-21.44ms for Adam, 30.15-30.36ms critic-only, and 33.00-33.08ms both (10 optimizer steps per rollout). Serial attempts take 87.6-109.9s including startup/compilation. Compiler cache and environment timing differ; do not infer aggregate throughput or end-to-end speedups from these serial attempts.
interpretation: [INFERENCE] Results are consistent with transport changing effective policy-update dynamics adversely, rather than a numerical blow-up. Lower KL is observed, but gradient alignment and full parameter-gradient transport error were not measured, so the causal mechanism is not established.

The asymptotic correction-to-fresh-gradient coefficient ratio is beta/(1-beta): 9 at beta .9 and 99 at beta .99. Thus unweighted C/g telemetry near .01 need not imply a negligible correction. It is not a measured optimizer-step ratio.

Unlike stationary regression, PPO refreshes behavior distribution, old policy log-probabilities, advantages and bootstrapped targets each rollout. The implemented transport corrects only model-output score drift at fixed current data and omits output-Jacobian drift; it cannot be assumed to carry old momentum across these objective changes correctly.

No damping, clipping, learning-rate rescue, new seed or longer-run fishing applied after seeing failure. A future redesign should first measure transport error and objective-boundary mismatch on captured PPO batches; this experiment does not identify either as the cause.
